t: An ESP32 robot kit with eight offline AI vision modes and block or Python coding.
steps: Buy the kit from a reseller. One page lists a 2 to 4 week lead time.
Ask IT to install WonderLab on a Windows computer.
Open a block project in Scratch.
Try one vision mode such as color recognition.
Try the Python Editor with older students.
Add the WonderEcho voice module if you buy it.
